why_ai: Brands' goods are still packed, kitted and labelled by hands and machines on a floor, and brand owners plan to keep or grow outsourcing, though packing robots and automated lines trim hand work at the edges.
why_clarity: Each job has an exact spec, count and ship date checked at pack-out, but short runs and constant new formats keep jobs from being identical.
why_digital: Physical product and components come in and physical packs go out, while brands source packagers regionally and nationally through RFQs.

why_ai: Drug packaging happens on cGMP lines where accountable QA staff release each lot, and demand grows with outsourcing and serialisation.
why_clarity: Batch records, line clearance and label reconciliation are codified rules with pass-or-fail release.
why_digital: Bulk drug and printed components become physical packs, though serial data is digital and sponsors buy across regions and borders.

why_ai: High-volume blister and bottle lines need physical operation and signed QA release, with serialisation adding regulated work rather than removing it.
why_clarity: The same products run for years under fixed specifications, and every lot is released or held within days.
why_digital: The packs are physical, but each carries a serialised data record shared electronically with trading partners.

why_ai: Blinded kits are packed by hand under GMP, and label content and campaign design need accountable judgement for each protocol.
why_clarity: Kits and labels are checkable against the protocol, but each trial and amendment differs and errors surface at sites weeks later.
why_digital: Label text and supply plans are digital, while the kits are physical and shipped to sites worldwide for global sponsors.

why_ai: Displays and club packs are assembled by hand from irregular components, which robots handle poorly, and retail programmes keep coming.
why_clarity: Each programme has a drawing, a count and a ship window, and pallets are accepted or refused at the retailer.
why_digital: Product and corrugate in, built displays out, with programmes ordered through EDI and sourced nationally.

why_ai: Food is repacked on registered lines under food safety plans and audits, with accountable people signing changeovers.
why_clarity: Specs, allergen rules and label checks are written down, but a mislabel may only surface at a recall.
why_digital: Bulk and finished food in, packed food out, sold mostly to regional brands that audit the plant in person.

why_ai: Held goods must be physically stickered and re-marked, sometimes under Customs supervision, though rule-reading and label design automate.
why_clarity: Compliance is checkable against marking and labelling rules, but each notice and product is a different case.
why_digital: Notices arrive digitally but the work is on physical goods near ports, bought through importers and brokers.

why_ai: Serving young brands means hand-holding through specs and retailer rules and running short physical jobs, though matching and quoting move online.
why_clarity: Each run has a spec and a count, but every small brand's first job is new and how to guide it varies.
why_digital: Brands find packagers online and send files, while the runs are physical.

why_ai: Small crews hand-pack and relabel for regional clients who choose them for responsiveness and trust.
why_clarity: Jobs are counted and shipped against a ticket, though methods live in the owner's head.
why_digital: Goods in and goods out by truck from nearby clients, run on paper and whiteboards.

why_ai: Checking labels and codes is exactly what cameras and models do, with humans left to handle exceptions and sign records.
why_clarity: Each unit's label, code and barcode is right or wrong against the job, checked instantly millions of times.
why_digital: Physical labels are imaged and judged on screen, with results logged digitally for clients and auditors.

why_ai: Estimating rests on tacit reads of samples that models can assist, but someone must stand behind the price.
why_clarity: The quote is graded by the run's actual cost, but estimators work by feel and the answer arrives weeks later.
why_digital: Specs and samples come in, the work is on screen and at the bench, and a priced quote goes out by email.

why_ai: Classifying packaging and filing reports against published rules is exposed to software, though statutory deadlines keep buyers paying for accountable filings.
why_clarity: Each SKU's materials map to defined categories and fee rates, and filings are accepted or queried.
why_digital: Packaging specs in, fee calculations and filed reports out, all online.

why_ai: Simulation tools automate the arithmetic, but sponsors pay for planners who stand behind GMP supply decisions.
why_clarity: Forecasts are judged by stock-outs and waste, which show up over the life of a trial.
why_digital: Trial data and plans are digital, delivered remotely to global sponsors.

why_ai: Serial data exchange is software against fixed standards, protected mainly by validation and network effects.
why_clarity: Events either conform to the standard and match the goods or they do not, at enormous volume.
why_digital: Entirely data exchanged between systems and sold as subscriptions.

why_ai: Market sizing reports built from interviews and desk research are highly exposed to AI-assisted research.
why_clarity: Reports are defined products, but nobody checks whether the market sizes were right.
why_digital: Interviews and data in, reports out, sold online worldwide.

why_ai: Machine analytics automate well, but the service relationship and field fixes behind them stay with the machine builder.
why_clarity: Stops, speeds and failures are measured and predictions are checked against the next breakdown.
why_digital: Telemetry from physical machines is analysed on screen and sold with service contracts.

why_ai: Measuring supplier compliance against written rules is exactly the work retail systems automate.
why_clarity: Each delivery is on time and in full or not, under published rules, millions of times a year.
why_digital: Receiving scans and orders in, scorecards and chargebacks out through supplier portals.

why_ai: Market analysis is exposed to AI, while format trials and customer relationships keep a physical and personal side.
why_clarity: Trials pass or fail, but market insight is judged by launches that succeed months later.
why_digital: Mostly data and design work, with physical trials and customer visits.

why_ai: Site surveillance, records review and enforcement are statutory acts by accountable officials, with investigators excluded from the insight function and site-risk selection increasingly model-driven.
why_clarity: Rules are written, but findings rest on investigators' judgement and enforcement outcomes take months.
why_digital: The surveillance and analysis work runs on registrations, inspection records and recall data on screen, while the agency is a sole national authority that cannot be bought from elsewhere.

why_ai: Choosing and managing co-packers rests on relationships and plant visits, while cost benchmarking automates.
why_clarity: Supplier scorecards are defined, but whether a co-packer choice was right shows up over seasons.
why_digital: Quotes and scorecards are digital, with audits and visits in person.

why_ai: Pricing and benchmarking analysis on internal data is exposed to automation.
why_clarity: Quotes are graded by job margins, but deal and pricing judgement varies by analyst.
why_digital: Internal data in, models and quotes out on screen.

why_ai: Workflow software and matching are directly exposed to AI-native competitors.
why_clarity: Software features and matches are defined and their use is measurable quickly.
why_digital: Entirely software and online matching.

why_ai: File and print comparison is a vision task that general AI models increasingly perform.
why_clarity: A comparison finds a difference or it does not, instantly and objectively.
why_digital: Files and scans in, comparison reports out, sold as software.

why_ai: Associations sell membership, networking and trade shows built on relationships, which AI does not replace.
why_clarity: Value to members is diffuse and judged by renewals.
why_digital: Reports are digital but the core product is meetings and trade shows in person.
